sections.Profile:
The "Double Barrel" pinball machine, released by Williams Electronic Manufacturing Corporation in August 1961, is a two-player electro-mechanical game designed by Steve Kordek, with artwork by George Molentin. This machine features two flippers, two pop bumpers, three passive bumpers, two slingshots, two gobble holes, two ball kickers, two standup targets, two rollover buttons, and a swinging target.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1961
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
